# Core shader programs (26.3)

Every core shader program the game compiles, with what each one can use.

- **Pipelines**: a program is compiled once per pipeline that uses it, with that pipeline's defines.
  A pack that replaces the file must compile and link for every one of them.
- **Always available**: uniforms every pipeline of this program provides.
- **Conditional**: uniforms only some pipelines provide. Declare them only under the given guard,
  otherwise the pipelines that don't provide them fail to load (see experiment 42).
- OIT bookkeeping defines (`OIT_WAVELET_RANK`, `OIT_COEFF_COUNT`, `OIT_COEFF_ATTACHMENT_COUNT`) are omitted.

Programs: [`core/animate_sprite`](#coreanimate_sprite), [`core/animate_sprite_blit`](#coreanimate_sprite_blit), [`core/animate_sprite_interpolate`](#coreanimate_sprite_interpolate), [`core/blit_depth`](#coreblit_depth), [`core/blit_screen`](#coreblit_screen), [`core/block`](#coreblock), [`core/clouds`](#coreclouds), [`core/debug_point`](#coredebug_point), [`core/entity`](#coreentity), [`core/glint`](#coreglint), [`core/gui`](#coregui), [`core/integrate_depth`](#coreintegrate_depth), [`core/item`](#coreitem), [`core/lightmap`](#corelightmap), [`core/oit_composite`](#coreoit_composite), [`core/oit_depth_bounds_cull`](#coreoit_depth_bounds_cull), [`core/panorama`](#corepanorama), [`core/particle`](#coreparticle), [`core/position_color`](#coreposition_color), [`core/position_tex`](#coreposition_tex), [`core/position_tex_color`](#coreposition_tex_color), [`core/rendertype_beacon_beam`](#corerendertype_beacon_beam), [`core/rendertype_crumbling`](#corerendertype_crumbling), [`core/rendertype_end_portal`](#corerendertype_end_portal), [`core/rendertype_entity_shadow`](#corerendertype_entity_shadow), [`core/rendertype_leash`](#corerendertype_leash), [`core/rendertype_lightning`](#corerendertype_lightning), [`core/rendertype_lines`](#corerendertype_lines), [`core/rendertype_outline`](#corerendertype_outline), [`core/rendertype_water_mask`](#corerendertype_water_mask), [`core/screenquad`](#corescreenquad), [`core/sky`](#coresky), [`core/stars`](#corestars), [`core/terrain`](#coreterrain), [`core/text`](#coretext), [`core/world_border`](#coreworld_border)
